title: Tool authorization allowlist
subtitle: Persisted "always allow" records — matching approvals are auto-approved instead of prompting every time.

list.title: Granted
list.description: Keyed by workspace + tool name. A read-only tool granted "always allow" in any session stays granted across sessions; removing it makes the next run ask again.

hint: For safety, only read-only tools (read / read_image / glob / grep / web_fetch / web_search) are persisted. Write and execution tools (edit / write / bash / pwsh, etc.) only apply to the current session and are never written to disk.
